description: The reader asks what they have said before about a specific habit. One stored record is their own earlier statement on exactly that habit; the others are unrelated reflections. Recall returns the matching record and nothing else.

input.cue: Have I written anything before about why I stopped practising in the mornings?

tool_evidence.excerpt: I stopped practising in the mornings after the commute changed. Evenings are the only time the flat is quiet enough to concentrate.
I have been reading more slowly this year and I think I am enjoying it more than when I raced through books.
Walking on Saturday mornings has become the part of the week I look forward to most.

criteria: Says briefly why the recalled record answers the question about morning practice
Returns the reader's own earlier statement without interpreting what it means about them
Does not propose a connection between the record and anything else
forbidden_claims: Draws a conclusion about the reader's discipline or character
Presents the unrelated reading or walking records as relevant
